review.reason: The observed changes implement a fallback strategy for Meta Ads warehouse ingestion: P1.F1.H4 adds a restart mechanism when page-limit retries exhaust, P1.F1.H5 unifies chunk-size fallback logic, and P1.F1.H6 clears the cursor and restarts the chunk at a smaller size. review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation of recovery and fallback mechanisms, but the actual benefit depends on unverified production behavior and the frequency of page-limit exhaustion, which are not demonstrated in the code.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new fallback strategy: when page-limit retries exhaust, the chunk size also shrinks and the chunk restarts from its first day.
observations.posthog_connection: Meta Ads warehouse ingestion; prevents request-looping and recovery from mid-chunk timeouts by narrowing the date window and re-requesting the chunk from its start.

observations.behavior: Replaces inline chunk-size-shrink logic with a helper and removes the page-limit-only fallback, allowing chunk-size fallback when page limits are exhausted.
observations.posthog_connection: Meta Ads warehouse ingestion; unifies chunk-size fallback behavior across initial and mid-chunk paths, supporting recovery when page limits cannot be reduced further.

observations.behavior: Adds chunk-size fallback when page-limit ladder bottoms out mid-chunk, clearing the cursor and restarting the chunk at a smaller size.
observations.posthog_connection: Meta Ads warehouse ingestion; recovery path when both page and chunk fallbacks are exhausted, avoiding request-looping and preserving deduplication.
